mechanism_narrative: Madrid's holiday shopping season spurs a seasonal rebound in retail and recreation. RETAIL_REC improved from -31.6 at t-3w to -27.9 at t-0w, and this momentum carries the next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: If the mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days, the seasonal rebound mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM returns to 0.0 from negative territory, it signals the end of precautionary stockpiling. Households redirect spending to retail and recreation, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM t-0w = 0.0, its highest value in the four-week window
regime_hint: steady state with no new restrictions
failure_condition: If next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is lower than last 28-day mean after GROCERY_PHARM crosses above 0.0, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated RESIDENTIAL combined with depressed WORKPLACES indicates home-centered routines. This keeps residents in local neighborhoods, increasing footfall for nearby retail and recreation over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If under RESIDENTIAL > 8 and WORKPLACES < -20 the next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is lower than the last 28-day mean, the interaction is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, PARKS below -20 for two consecutive weeks signals suppressed outdoor mobility and stricter enforcement. Retail and recreation follow downward, pushing the next 28-day mean below the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: If PARKS remains below -20 for two weeks but next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC exceeds the last 28-day mean, the tightening mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp week-on-week rise in TRANSIT signals renewed movement and confidence. Retail and recreation footfall follows quickly, raising RETAIL_REC within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT t-0w = -31.6 vs t-1w = -38.9, a 7.3 point rise
failure_condition: If after a TRANSIT week-on-week rise > 5 points the next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is lower than the last 28-day mean, the transit-lead hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: Joint recovery in TRANSIT above -33 and WORKPLACES above -25 signals restored commuting and leisure travel. Their interaction reinforces retail and recreation over the next four weeks, lifting RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: If both TRANSIT > -33 and WORKPLACES > -25 occur but next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is lower than the last 28-day mean, the joint-recovery interaction is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A WORKPLACES value below -30 indicates severe workplace closures under tightening restrictions. Retail and recreation demand contracts further, driving the next 28-day mean below the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES t-1w = -37.3, the lowest in the four-week window
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES falls below -30 but next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is higher than the last 28-day mean, the severe-closure mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Stable or falling PARKS mobility below -20 indicates outdoor leisure is constrained, shifting spending toward indoor retail venues. This substitution lifts RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: If PARKS remains below -20 for two consecutive weeks but next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC is lower than the last 28-day mean, the substitution hypothesis fails.
